display_name: General Business Law, Article 44-B (Responsible AI Safety and Education (RAISE) Act)
citation: N.Y. Gen. Bus. Law §§ 1420-1429, as repealed and re-added by L. 2026, ch. 96 (S.8828), effective January 1, 2027; first added by L. 2025, ch. 699 (S.6953-B)
instrument_kind: statute (an article of a New York consolidated law), with the enacting and amending bills' uncodified sections
authority: New York State Legislature; bill texts published by the New York State Assembly

source.versions: Two vintages: the article as re-added by L. 2026, ch. 96 (ny-s8828-2026-ch-96, encoded), and the article as first added by L. 2025, ch. 699 (ny-s6953b-2025-ch-699, deposited to show what changed; repealed and replaced by L. 2026, ch. 96, § 2. Whether the ch. 699 article was briefly in force, between its original effective date (the 90th day after 2025-12-19; a plain count, not a General Construction Law computation, gives 2026-03-19) and ch. 96's signing on 2026-03-27, is not decided here).
